request: the LLM key setting should track an installed client's gateway configuration by default

provenance.recoveredSampleModules: none; this package adds no port and cites no recovered coordinate
provenance.priorArt: bin/litcode-magpie.mjs already borrowed ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL named the same endpoint; the reader is now shared so the CLI and the launcher cannot drift

file.directory: LLM_INHERIT_DIR, else the client's own configuration-directory variable, else <home>/.claude
file.nothingElse: the client credential store, its session records and any authorization flow are never read

reads.environment: the same variable names fill any field the file does not name
refusals: not a regular file, or a directory in its place
malformed JSON, non-object document, non-object env block
value past its bound: credential 8192, URL 2048, model 256 characters
endpoint that is not an absolute http/https URL

rules.detail: flag, then LLM_* environment, then this harness's settings.json, then inheritance; a resumed session keeps its pinned endpoint and borrows only the credential for it

sameGateway compares origin plus path ignoring trailing slashes; a borrowed credential is never used for an endpoint the client did not name, and a client that names a credential but no endpoint contributes nothing

rules.rule: report the source, never the value
rules.detail: one stderr line names the variable and file per field; nothing prints a value and no credential enters the session configuration or a journal
the token variable is a bearer credential and the key variable is not; the default auth comes from the variable read, and LLM_AUTH/--auth override it

changes.what: new reader with the bounds, the directory search and the endpoint comparison

gateway/credential resolution, the precedence chain, --inherit-gateway/--no-inherit-gateway and LLM_INHERIT_GATEWAY, the source notice, the missing-credential message that names a refused endpoint, and the pinned-endpoint credential on --resume
shares the reader, falls back to the environment alone without a build, passes LLM_AUTH for a key-variable credential
install section, configuration table row and the resume/authentication notes

endToEnd.command: env -i PATH=... HOME=... TERM=xterm litcode --workspace <temp> (PTY, then /exit)
endToEnd.result: all three fields inherited from the client settings file, session opened, exited on /exit, 0 model calls
endToEnd.note: no live model call was made in this package
